title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Waste Management - WasteManagementFacility
description: A facility authorized to manage/treat waste, e.g. a classification or treatment plant (edintwaste:WasteManagementFacility, subclass of edintwaste:WasteFacility, edint-infraestructura's Facility).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WasteManagementFacility'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

address.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/address'. The mailing address (reusing esdir:DireccionPostal). Inherited from WasteFacility.

belongsTo.description: Relationship. Territorial unit(s) (Barrio, Distrito or Municipio) this facility belongs to (edintwaste:belongsTo). Modeled as an array since the source's own real example data shows a WasteContainer belonging to both a Barrio and a Distrito simultaneously. Inherited from WasteFacility.

contactPoint.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/ContactPoint'. Contact point for this facility.

legalName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/legalName'. The facility's legal (company) name.

hasManagementScope.description: Property. Scope(s) of waste management authorized for this facility, from the ManagementScope controlled vocabulary (edintwaste:hasManagementScope). Kept as an open string rather than a fixed enum -- the source's own example data uses a notation ('ClasificacionResiduosNoPeligrososTrituracionMadera') that doesn't exactly match any concept published in this repository's own kos/skos-ManagementScope.ttl ('ClasificacionDeResiduosNoPeligrososYTrituracionDeMadera'); see standard-metadata.yaml.

hasTreatmentProcess.description: Property. Treatment process(es) performed at this facility, from the TreatmentProcess controlled vocabulary (edintwaste:hasTreatmentProcess). Same open-string treatment as hasManagementScope, for the same reason.

managesWasteType.description: Property. Waste type(s) managed by this facility, from the WasteType controlled vocabulary (edintwaste:managesWasteType).

isConstructionDemolitionWasteManager.description: Property. Whether this facility manages construction/demolition waste (edintwaste:isConstructionDemolitionWasteManager).

nif.description: Property. Spanish tax identification number (NIF) of the managing organization (edintwaste:nif).

nima.description: Property. Spanish environmental register identifier (NIMA) of the facility (edintwaste:nima).

registrationNumber.description: Property. The facility's waste-management authorization/registration number (edintwaste:registrationNumber).

registrationType.description: Property. Type of authorization/registration held, e.g. 'Autorización de gestión de residuos no peligrosos' (edintwaste:registrationType). The source ontology does not constrain this to a controlled vocabulary.
